changelog: Text messages and WhatsApp (Modules\Sms). An optional mobile number on the form with its own unticked consent box; alerts and reminders go by text or WhatsApp (approved Twilio templates) next to email, in the shopper's language. Consent is kept per channel, so a shop switching from texts to WhatsApp messages nobody who agreed only to the other. A STOP reply removes the number. Providers: Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, Brevo and ClickSend, through the shared creativebranding/sms package (copied into src/Vendor/Sms by tools/sms-sync.sh); the account is shared with Creative Shipment Tracking 1.11.0 and later.

Team alerts (Modules\TeamAlerts) to Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams or a webhook signed with HMAC-SHA256: a restock detected or ended, demand reaching a threshold (once per crossing), and the morning digest. Item names are escaped for each destination's markup; shoppers' details are never sent.

Marketing sync (Modules\MarketingSync) to Klaviyo, Mailchimp or MailerLite for shoppers who ticked the marketing box and confirmed, from a background job. Unsubscribes go both ways where the service allows (/creative-restock/v1/marketing/{secret}, signatures checked).
Unsubscribing from every back-in-stock email also withdraws marketing consent (RequestService::withdrawMarketing()).
Uninstall removes the modules' options, jobs and marks, and the shared SMS account once no plugin uses it.
